definitions.explanation: a small bowl specifically used for serving and eating rice

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{飯椀|めしわん}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a new rice bowl.

examples.japanese: {家族|かぞく}それぞれ{専用|せんよう}の{飯椀|めしわん}がある。
examples.english: Each family member has their own rice bowl.

examples.japanese: この{飯椀|めしわん}は{祖母|そぼ}から{受|う}け{継|つ}いだものだ。
examples.english: This rice bowl was passed down from my grandmother.

notes:
JAPANESE TABLEWARE:
In Japanese households, each family member often has their own designated {飯椀|めしわん}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {茶碗|ちゃわん} - also commonly used for rice bowl (despite literally meaning "tea bowl")
- ご{飯|はん}{茶碗|ぢゃわん} - rice bowl (more common term)

RELATED TABLEWARE:
- {汁椀|しるわん} - soup bowl
- お{椀|わん} - bowl (general)
- {丼|どんぶり} - large bowl for rice dishes
- {茶碗|ちゃわん} - tea bowl / rice bowl

MATERIALS:
- {陶器|とうき} - ceramic
- {磁器|じき} - porcelain
- {漆器|しっき} - lacquerware
- {木製|もくせい} - wooden
